title: The SPARC Architecture Manual, Version 9
version: First printing 1994; University of Texas copy is revision SAV09R1459912

passages.note: The specification defines the 64-bit instruction and register architecture, virtual addresses, traps and memory model, with upward compatibility for conforming 32-bit nonprivileged applications.

lineage: University of Texas mirror of a revised copy carrying a 1994–2000 copyright. The 1994 first-printing date is separately verified.
